'''Stasis vault 113''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] vault in the [[the Tomb]], an ancient [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Located in the [[Ancient Stasis Zone]] of the Tomb, the stasis vault was damaged during the [[invasion of Belsavis]] and the creatures it contained unleashed into the Tomb. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Larek]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sent several [[Droid/Legends|droids]] into the vault to recover [[Memory bank/Legends|memory cores]] from Rakata security droids, but when the droids failed to return, he recruited Republic personnel in the area to do so.

==Behind the scenes==
Stasis vault 113 appears as a location on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and is the site of the Republic mission "Unheard Frequencies."<ref name="TOR" />
